name: Mobara (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mobara city emblem in white: two interlocking outlined rings.
history: Municipal flag of Mobara, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 July 1952.

features.role: Mobara city emblem — two interlocking outlined rings
